name: relay
description: A second way to reach the box besides Tailscale: the box dials out to a relay, and devices paired by QR code reach it over an end-to-end encrypted channel.

tips.text: Run `vyre relay pair` and scan the QR code with your phone's camera to reach the box without Tailscale.
Run `vyre relay` to see whether the relay is on and connected, and how many devices are paired.
Run `vyre relay devices` to see which paired devices are connected, and whether through the relay or direct.
Run `vyre relay trust <id>` to give a browser paired from the web app its full powers; `--off` limits it again.
Run `vyre relay remove <id>` for a lost phone: it is unpaired and its open connections close.
Run `vyre relay pin <release>` to hold the web app at one build, and `vyre relay unpin` to follow the newest.
Run `vyre relay rename <id> alex iphone` so the device list says which phone is which.
Run `vyre relay off` to stop the relay; paired devices stay paired for when you run `vyre relay on`.
